--- title: Results summary --- This page compiles the results of all the performed contrasts: in lysogeny, intra-strain time-course and inter-strain time-course. # Load data In this code chunk, we load the RDS objects, the counts and the annotation file. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} load_summaries() build_functional_enrichments() lysogeny_counts <- readRDS(file = "lysogeny_counts.rds") lytic_cycle_induction_counts <- readRDS(file = "lytic_cycle_induction_counts.rds") annotation <- readRDS(file = "GBJ002-GIL01-GIL16.rds") ``` ::: # Lysogeny summaries This section presents the results of the lysogeny contrasts. The two bar charts show the total number of DE genes and the number of enrichments in each contrast. In addition, the enrichments in the COG and KEGG categories are represented in two bubble plots to facilitate comparison between contrasts. Finally, the interactive table compiles all the results from the **Enrichment summary** tables for each contrast. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} lysogeny_contrasts <- combine_summaries(type = "contrast", group = "strains", filter = "Lysogeny") lysogeny_enrichments <- combine_summaries(type = "enrichment", group = "strains", filter = "Lysogeny") ``` ::: ## Barplots This plot shows the number of DE genes, both upregulated and downregulated, in each contrast. As we can see, the GIL01 vs GBJ002 contrast has the fewest DE genes, while the GIL16 vs GBJ002 contrast has the most. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} lysogeny_contrasts_size <- lysogeny_contrasts %>% select(Contrast, DE, Size) %>% mutate( Contrast = factor(Contrast, levels = levels(lysogeny_contrasts$Contrast)), DE = factor(DE, levels = levels(lysogeny_contrasts$DE)) ) ggplot(lysogeny_contrasts_size, aes(x = Contrast, y = Size, fill = DE)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75, alpha = 0.7) + geom_text( aes(label = Size), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.4, size = 4 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("UP" = "red", "DOWN" = "blue")) + ylim(0, 600) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + labs(x = NULL, y = "DE genes", fill = "DE") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](results_summary_files/figure-html/lysogeny_cs-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: This plot shows the number of enrichments found in each category. Most enrichments are found in the MF and CC categories of GO, while the fewest are found in the EC numbers. Again, the GIL01 vs GBJ002 contrast has the fewest enrichments, while the GIL16 vs GBJ002 contrast has the most. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} lysogeny_contrasts_enrichments <- lysogeny_contrasts %>% pivot_longer( cols = !c(Group, Contrast, DE), names_to = "Category", values_to = "Count" ) %>% filter(Category != "Size") %>% mutate( Contrast = factor(Contrast, levels = levels(lysogeny_contrasts$Contrast)), DE = factor(DE, levels = levels(lysogeny_contrasts$DE)), Category = factor(Category, levels = colnames(lysogeny_contrasts)[4:ncol(lysogeny_contrasts)]) ) ggplot(lysogeny_contrasts_enrichments, aes(x = Category, y = Count, fill = DE)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75, alpha = 0.7) + geom_text( aes(label = ifelse(Count == 0, NA, Count)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.4, size = 4 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("UP" = "red", "DOWN" = "blue")) + scale_x_discrete(labels = c("COG", "KEGG", "GO (BP)", "GO (MF)", "GO (CC)", "EC (1)", "EC (2)", "EC (3)")) + facet_wrap(~ Contrast, nrow = 3) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 40), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Enrichments", fill = "DE") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](results_summary_files/figure-html/lysogeny_ce-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Venn diagrams Venn diagrams were used to evaluate the overlap of differentially expressed genes associated with lysogeny among the three pairwise strain comparisons. ``` ::: ::: # Inter-strain time-course summaries This section presents the results of the inter-strain time-course contrasts. The two bar charts show the total number of DE genes and the number of enrichments in each contrast per strain. In addition, the enrichments in the COG and KEGG categories are represented in two bubble plots to facilitate comparison between contrasts. Finally, the interactive table compiles all the results from the **Enrichment summary** tables for each contrast. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} inter_strain_time_course_contrasts <- combine_summaries(type = "contrast", group = "strains", filter = c("t0", "t10", "t30", "t60", "t60-mock")) inter_strain_time_course_enrichments <- combine_summaries(type = "enrichment", group = "strains", filter = c("t0", "t10", "t30", "t60", "t60-mock")) ``` ::: ## Barplots This plot shows the number of DE genes, both upregulated and downregulated, in each time per strains contrasts. As we can see, the highest number of DE genes are obtained at late time points, and especially in the contrasts of GBJ002 vs GIL01 and GIL16. This is because a combined model was used for all contrasts (i.e. a single DESeq2 object), reflecting that, considering both time and strain, the greatest transcriptional changes are found at late time points. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} inter_strain_time_course_contrasts_size <- inter_strain_time_course_contrasts %>% select(Group, Contrast, DE, Size) %>% mutate( Group = factor(Group, levels = levels(inter_strain_time_course_contrasts$Group)), Contrast = factor(Contrast, levels = levels(inter_strain_time_course_contrasts$Contrast)), DE = factor(DE, levels = levels(inter_strain_time_course_contrasts$DE)) ) ggplot(inter_strain_time_course_contrasts_size, aes(x = Group, y = Size, fill = DE)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75, alpha = 0.7) + geom_text( aes(label = Size), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.4, size = 4 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("UP" = "red", "DOWN" = "blue")) + scale_x_discrete(labels = c(0, 10, 30, 60, "60-mock")) + facet_wrap(~ Contrast, ncol = 1) + ylim(0, 700) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) + labs(x = "Time points (min)", y = "DE genes", fill = "DE") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](results_summary_files/figure-html/inter_strain_time_course_cs-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: This plot shows the number of enrichments found in each category.
